cover.title: 5 niche ways to get cited by chatgpt before your european rivals

inner.title: audit 30 prompts
inner.body: ask chatgpt 30 to 50 questions your buyers ask, in two separate sessions, and write down every domain it cites (llm pulse playbook, a vendor guide). if your rivals appear and you don't, that is your real ranking.

inner.title: write prices as text
inner.body: ahrefs found 75.9% of chatgpt's site: lookups on the most-searched domains went to brand sites (study dated 12 oct 2026). a pricing page that's a pdf or an image gives the model nothing to quote.

inner.title: earn coverage
inner.body: muck rack's may 2026 study of 25m+ links found 84% of citations came from earned media and 1.1% from press releases. a release is not a mention, a journalist writing about you is.

inner.title: stop seeding reddit
inner.body: ahrefs' us data shows reddit going from about 1 in 5 chatgpt answers in march to about 1 in 43 by late september. the thread you spent a month on may now be worth nothing.

inner.title: publish something new monthly
inner.body: 57% of journalism citations were under 12 months old, and they peak in the first month after publishing (muck rack). last year's coverage is fading while your rival's from last week is not.

closer.HEADLINE:
most chatgpt answers
never run a search.
closer.SUBLINE: so the sources it already trusts decide who gets named.
